TC-20/S04a.title: Nursing Home: In Today yes/no decides who is counted (TFA-92587 AC 6, TFA-92598 AC 4)
TC-20/S04a.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts driving the app UI. Judged 3/3. 9 residents seeded with the run prefix (7 In Today in mixed statuses, Fay pending and Gus complete not in today); the shared account had no other rows. The Nursing Home dashboard opens on Today's Visits with Total 7 (all residents: 9) and lists exactly the 7 In Today residents. B25 (dashboard counted every resident) does not reproduce on dev.
